items.title: Benefits of OOP: Modularity, Reusability, and Easier Maintenance

source_refs.note: Unnumbered heading Benefits of OOP: Modularity, Reusability, and Easier Maintenance under 3.1, with its Tidbit, as printed (PDF 37, printed 33).

blocks.text: OOP allows code to be divided into modules, making it easier to manage. Classes and objects can be reused in multiple programs or parts of a program, reducing repetition. Programs built with OOP are easier to maintain and update because changes in one part do not affect the entire system. The structure of OOP supports scalability and adaptability in software development. It also improves collaboration by making code more understandable and organized.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming helps programmers think in terms of real-life objects, like students or cars, making programs easier to understand and manage.
